messages:
Alex: Quick design review — attaching a screenshot of the new metrics card. Question: gridlines feel heavy and the y-axis numbers look noisy for small values. Thoughts on reducing visual weight + unit abbreviation behavior? https://img.redwood.test/snap.png
Maria: Agree, gridlines are too bold. Drop to 10-12% opacity, or use dashed thin lines for minor gridlines. Also prefer fewer ticks for small ranges.
Kevin: For accessibility, we need >= 3:1 contrast for gridlines vs bg? I think guidance is 2:1 for decorative elements, but check WCAG. If we lower opacity we should keep line thickness at 1px.
Jia: For units, can we standardize on SI prefixes (k, M) but only after >= 1000? Right now 999 becomes 0.999k which is confusing. Also prefer spacing: "1k" -> "1 k" or no? I vote no space for compact UI.
Alex: Good call on 999 — that edge-case trips customers. Suggest rule: show full integer <1000, switch to 1k style at >=1000, format 3 sig figs for smaller numbers (e.g., 1.23k).
Maria: For smoothing, the toggle label is ambiguous. Current copy is "smoothing on/off". Propose "line smoothing (preserve spikes)" with an info tooltip.
Kevin: Spikes need special handling — smoothing should never hide critical outliers used for alerts. Behavior: smoothing applies to visual only, not to underlying thresholds. Add aria-describedby to explain this for screen readers.
Jia: Legend ordering — current legend sorts alphabetically. For stacked area charts we should match stack order (top->bottom) so users can map color->series visually. Also add a small caret to collapse long legends.
Alex: Agreed on stack ordering. For long series names, truncate with ellipsis but show full name on hover and in a11y label.
Maria: Small copy nit: change unit suffix from "ops/s" to "ops·s⁻¹" in tooltip only? I'm torn. The dot is more technical. Maybe keep simple "ops/s" everywhere but add math notation in docs.
Kevin: Keep UI simple for glanceability: "ops/s". Docs can show alternate notation. Also ensure screen reader reads "operations per second" (aria-label).
Jia: Proposing these actionable rules in a short spec: 1) gridlines: 10% opacity, 1px, minor dashed; 2) ticks: max 5, prefer nice numbers; 3) units: full int <1000, SI >=1000 with 3 sig figs; 4) smoothing: visual-only, tooltip + aria note; 5) legend: stack order, truncate+tooltip. Happy to write a PR for visual tokens.
Alex: Awesome — can you draft the PR for visual tokens and a short token map for gridline+tick rules? I'll review.
Maria: I'll do the copy changes in the UI strings file and leave comments for product on docs wording.
Kevin: I'll add the aria labels and a test case for screen reader output.
Jia: PR prep done checklist: add screenshots, before/after, and edge-case example for 999 vs 1k.
designbot: New design checklist created: https://design.redwood/checklists/chart-visuals — assigned: Maria, Jia, Kevin — due: 3 days. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Thanks — small follow-up: could we run the existing chart with colorblind palette v2 and compare? I'd like a quick contrast snapshot in the PR.
Maria: Will add an AB screenshot pair.
Kevin: Will run axe contrast check and ping results in thread.
Alex: Great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
